enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the fan on for cooling.
enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Turns on fan. Closes eyes. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Reaches for fan remote. Presses button to increase fan speed. Puts remote down. Turns to back. Breathes steadily. Turns to left side again. Pulls blanket down. Turns to right side. Reaches for fan remote. Presses button to decrease fan speed. Puts remote down. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering, brushing teeth and getting ready for the workday.
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Picks up toothbrush. Turns on tap. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Puts down toothbrush. Turns off tap. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Washes body. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, drinking extra water to hydrate ahead of the hot day.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs, bread, milk. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out bowl, plate, pan. Closes cupboard. Cracks eggs into bowl. Whisks eggs. Turns on induction cooker. Pours eggs into pan. Stirs eggs. Turns off induction cooker. Puts eggs on plate. Puts bread in toaster. Presses toaster lever. Spreads butter on toast. Eats breakfast. Drinks water. Drinks more water.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing the work bag.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out work clothes. Closes wardrobe. Takes off sleepwear. Puts on work clothes. Takes out work bag. Opens work bag. Puts computer into work bag. Puts phone into work bag. Zips work bag. Walks out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital in the morning heat.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks out of house. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Checks phone. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone again. Gets off bus. Walks to hospital. Enters hospital. Walks to locker room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the hospital, seeing patients and carrying out clinical care duties.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to ward. Picks up patient chart. Reviews chart. Walks to patient room. Knocks on door. Enters room. Greets patient. Washes hands. Examines patient. Uses stethoscope. Takes blood pressure. Writes notes. Walks to nurse station. Uses computer. Updates records. Walks to next patient. Talks to patient. Administers medication. Walks to supply room. Restocks supplies.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and rehydrating during the shift.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to cafeteria. Selects food. Pays for food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats food. Drinks water. Refills water bottle. Drinks more water. Wipes mouth with napkin. Throws away trash. Walks back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical care duties and patient record work at the hospital.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to patient room. Examines patient. Talks to patient. Walks to computer. Types notes. Prints documents. Files documents. Walks to lab. Picks up results. Walks to doctor's office. Discusses with colleague. Walks to patient. Explains results. Walks to nurse station. Answers phone. Takes message. Walks to supply room. Restocks supplies. Walks to break room. Drinks water.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home through the afternoon heatwave.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks out of hospital. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Checks phone. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Gets off bus. Walks home. Unlocks door. Enters house. Closes door. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower to wash off the day and lower body temperature.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature to cool. Steps into shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Washes body. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around body. Turns off bathroom light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out pot and pan. Closes cupboard. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Adds oil. Adds ingredients. Stirs food. Turns off induction cooker. Picks up plate. Serves food. Sits at table. Eats food. Drinks water. Clears table. Puts dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the kitchen and loading the dishwasher.
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up dishes. Scrapes food into trash. Rinses dishes. Opens dishwasher. Loads dishes into dishwasher. Adds detergent. Closes dishwasher. Presses start button. Wipes counters with cloth. Washes pots by hand. Dries pots. Puts away pots. Sweeps floor. Throws away trash. Turns off kitchen light. Walks out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV and using the computer with the fan running instead of the air-conditioner during the evening peak tax hours.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Turns on living room light. Turns on fan. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Picks up computer. Opens laptop. Browses internet. Picks up phone. Sends message. Puts down phone. Watches TV. Gets up. Gets snack. Sits down. Turns off TV. Turns off fan. Turns off living room light. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Night wash routine and getting ready for bed.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on tap. Wets face. Applies cleanser. Rinses face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Puts down toothbrush. Turns off tap. Picks up towel. Dries face. Turns off bathroom light. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Going to bed and sleeping with the fan on for cooling.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on bedroom light. Takes off clothes. Puts on pajamas. Pulls back blanket. Lies down on bed. Turns on fan. Closes eyes. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Reaches for fan remote. Presses button to adjust fan speed. Puts remote down. Continues sleeping.
